results.title: Nepal seeks faster climate disaster funding, recognition of vulnerabilities after deadly floods - TRT World
results.snippet:
Nepal’s appeal follows a massive rock-and-ice collapse in the Langtang region that unleashed a surge of water, mud and debris through the Nepal-China border corridor on August 26.

At least 1,451 people were killed and 5,745 remained missing in Nepal, according to national disaster authority figures. Chinese authorities reported another 43 deaths and 519 missing. [...] TRT World - Nepal floods, mu

results.title: Major leaders missing as COP31 runs in Turkey - Taipei Times
results.snippet:
World leaders yesterday took the stage at COP31 in Antalya, Turkey, but some prominent names are missing from this year’s annual UN climate summit even as global warming intensifies.

The two-week conference started earlier this week in the Mediterranean resort city of Antalya, with governments under pressure to tackle the climate crisis after a year of heat waves in Europe, deadly floods in Nepal
